`*.synthetic.*` are explicitly synthetic fixtures for edge cases. `profile.live.html` is a sanitized, reduced real Koffi Kouao response captured on 2026-09-06; its ID and URL are in the accompanying metadata. `performance.leistungsdaten.live.html` records the client-rendered structure of Sarvar Abdukhamidov's public page: it has no statistics rows, so the parser must reject it safely. `performance.tmapi.sarvar.json` is a minimal representative structure from the public page's own TMAPI component request. No cookies, session headers, scripts, forms or tracking payloads are stored. Normal tests use disk fixtures and mocked fetch, never the live site.
